Chat.description_en: Conducts a streaming conversation with JVS Crew using the Server-Sent Events (SSE) protocol to push conversation content in real time
Chat.description_zh: 与 JVS Crew 进行流式对话，采用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 协议实时推送对话内容

GetAccessToken.description_en: Retrieves an access token (AccessToken) required for user conversations, used to authenticate when invoking the Chat operation
GetAccessToken.description_zh: 获取用户进行对话所需的访问令牌（AccessToken），用于后续调用 Chat 接口进行身份验证
